verdict.rationale: Obsidian Sync explicitly includes 'Version history - View or restore previous versions of a note' as a documented feature, confirmed on both the help docs and the sync product page, which also implies recovery of deleted notes via version snapshots. This is first-party documentation without independent hands-on corroboration of the restore flow itself. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation of restoring deleted notes specifically, and details on retention limits/duration of version history.
